name: ratatosk
description: Open-source browser extension that collects supplier invoices and receipts from vendor portals using the user's own session — no credential custody.

scripts.build:collector: npm run gen:icons && vite build --config collector/vite.config.ts
scripts.release:collector: npm run assert:release-source && npm run ci && npm run audit:security && npm run build:collector && npm run assert:release-source && npm run package:collector && npm run validate:collector-release
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.core.json && tsc -p tsconfig.extension.json && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p tsconfig.boundary-core.json && tsc -p tsconfig.boundary-extension.json && tsc -p tsconfig.boundary-node.json
scripts.test:chrome-discovery: npx playwright-core install chromium && npm run build:collector && npm run test:chrome-discovery:built
scripts.test:chrome-acquisition: npx playwright-core install chromium && npm run build:collector && scripts/run-chrome-discovery.sh --acquisition
scripts.test:discovery-iteration: npx playwright-core install chromium && npm run build:collector && scripts/run-chrome-discovery.sh
scripts.prepare:live-supplier-test: npm run assert:release-source && npm run ci && npm run audit:security && npm run build:collector && npm run test:chrome-discovery:built && npm run test:chrome-acquisition:built && npm run assert:release-source && npm run package:collector && npm run verify:collector-artifact && tsx scripts/prepare-live-supplier-test.ts
scripts.validate:collector-release: npm run validate:release && npm run test:collector-release-regressions && npm run test:chrome-discovery:built && npm run test:chrome-acquisition:built && npm run verify:collector-artifact && tsx scripts/validate-semantic-dom-acceptance.ts
scripts.ci: npm run gen:icons && npm run typecheck && npm run check:boundaries && npm run validate && npm run test
